verdict.rationale: Morph documents an OpenAI-compatible base URL (`https://api.morphllm.com/v1`), a `/v1/messages` endpoint, and model names passed via the `model` string. Nothing in the evidence documents a GET /v1/models-style endpoint for listing the live model catalog programmatically. OpenAI SDK compatibility is an adjacent capability and does not establish that a catalog endpoint exists, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404.
